instructions: Pay-per-call x402 utility tools for AI agents, plus a free per-IP tier. Discovery and the free tier need no account and no API key. Paid tools settle an x402 payment header. Start with free_tier; upgrade to the x402_* tools for the AI-backed ones.

tools.name: x402_brief
tools.description: Answers a question with a one-page brief of cited source URLs, key findings and open gaps. Paid: 0.25 USDC per call over x402 (HTTP 402).

tools.name: x402_data-clean
tools.description: Cleans a CSV/TSV/JSON table: removes duplicate and blank rows, normalises headers, returns tidy JSON. Paid: 0.5 USDC per call over x402 (HTTP 402).

tools.name: x402_code-review
tools.description: Reviews a code snippet and returns line-numbered findings (static rules plus AI review). Paid: 0.75 USDC per call over x402 (HTTP 402).

tools.name: x402_url-meta
tools.description: Fetches one public URL and returns machine-readable title, description, headings and links. Paid: 0.03 USDC per call over x402 (HTTP 402).

tools.name: x402_csv-json
tools.description: Converts tabular data between CSV/TSV and a JSON array. Paid: 0.02 USDC per call over x402 (HTTP 402).

tools.name: x402_regex
tools.description: Applies one regular expression to a text blob and returns all matches with positions. Paid: 0.01 USDC per call over x402 (HTTP 402).

tools.name: x402_diff
tools.description: Returns the line-level diff between two texts as added/removed lines. Paid: 0.01 USDC per call over x402 (HTTP 402).

tools.name: free_tier
tools.description: Free, rate-limited (25 calls per IP per day) versions of url-meta, csv-json, regex and diff. Start here - no payment, no signup.
